reviewDispositions.outcome: Parent changed render() to return meaningful loaded/empty/dashboard messages and reload() to announce them, while save() preserves its final success notice. Full replay on the changed source strictly asserts #notice initial no projects, selected project no tasks after reload, unmatched filters no results/recovery, dashboard and loaded totals, and project/task save success. Source hashes were stable during replay; historical pre-fix results remain archived.

audit() asserts bundled axe version, violations=[] and incomplete=[], and both counts must be present/zero. Every flow fails for nonempty/unavailable browser errors. Every flow fails for unexpected/unavailable console messages. Only named negative-resource 400/409 messages in base/graph and explicit offline network errors in base are classified separately; latest replay has no console messages or browser errors at all. Arbitrary audit payloads cannot pass.

Parent replaced generic labeled div with semantic nav. All four flows replayed once on final source; browser accessibility snapshots confirm named Pagination navigation landmark, and tested editor/task-list axe payloads have zero violations and zero incomplete results. Historical serious aria-prohibited-attr observations remain archived rather than erased.

criteria.conclusion: Fresh schema2/revision0 HTTP and browser empty state; native actual CLI occupied-lock/port and graceful-close cases. Nine owned real app processes exit zero in each all-flow replay.

nativeResult.scope: Independent execution of existing assertions; includes parent-added command/diagnosis/query tests present at execution. These are NOT counted as browser proof or as the parent-controlled I5 experiment.

limitations: AC07 announcement and semantic-pagination findings are fixed and independently verified on final parent-patched source. Tested axe pages have no unresolved findings, but this is not full WCAG or an all-AC green verdict.
Human design approval and full WCAG/screen-reader behavior were not verified.
Native Windows Ctrl+C was not sent: test-only IPC emits the actual CLI SIGTERM handler; real PID termination/restart and lock release were verified.
Final integrated tree, parent diagnosis, ESM metrics/probe interpretation, fixed evaluation and PR remain parent-owned.

Initial failures are retained: unavailable arm64 CLI candidate; daemon-inherited pipe close wait despite successful command; offscreen click and unsupported text-selector harness mistakes. They are not production app failures. Explicit scroll/native semantic locators and owned-PID exit waiting fixed the runner.
Native current suite had 37 tests because parent work added tests after implementation baseline of 32. No test count is used as UI proof.
